leftEvidence.title: Preparation, desire, cups, bread, remembrance, covenant blood, and betrayal unfold among the apostles

points.label: Setting
points.left: The day of Unleavened Bread and the prepared Passover locate the meal.
points.right: The night of betrayal locates the received tradition without naming Passover.

points.label: Bread and cup
points.left: An opening cup precedes bread, and a cup after supper follows.
points.right: Bread is followed by the cup after supper.

points.label: Horizon
points.left: Fulfillment and the coming Kingdom appear in Jesus’s sayings.
points.right: Repeated eating and drinking proclaim death until he comes.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: Bread, cup, remembrance, proclamation, and coming are delivered to the Corinthian assembly

payload.tension: The Corinthian tradition preserves core table actions and remembrance while omitting Luke’s explicit Passover preparation and opening cup.
payload.title: The Passover table and received remembrance
